name: Miracle Blessing
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield. {Discover} {derived:Caraboo's Blessing} cards with [Arg2] different {Prices}, choose [Arg3] to place into your Draw Pile.
lore:
<Italic:"Want boundless treasure?"
"Want unlimited power?"
"Want a divine elixir to raise the dead?"
"Want a crystal ball to see into hearts?"
"Want a charm to win back your beloved's heart?"
"Want a magic mirror that answers every question?"
"Want a honeyfruit to sate every desire in an instant?">
Whatever wish you make, we have it all right here.
Now, show your sincerity. Present your offerings to the Fairy Godmother!
The miracle is descending. Please, wait but 3 seconds!
3, 2, 1—and... off she scampers!
